name: ontodynamics
description: Complete E0 canonical landscape. Layer 1: Ontodynamics (pre-physical primitives). Layer 2: Canon Plain (operative structure, Axiom A0). Layer 3: AGI Blueprint (operational cycle, reflexivity emergence, structural alignment, domain invariance, negative necessity thesis). Derivation order encoded in delta topology.

nodes.label: Difference
nodes.description: Primitive, effective, directed, scaled. Entities are the result of stabilized difference.

nodes.label: Local Realization
nodes.description: Difference can be realized partially, not only globally. Minimal condition for actuality.

nodes.label: Connection
nodes.description: Elementary topological operation. Multiple difference components realized together.

nodes.label: Gradual Overlap
nodes.description: Connections possess degree. Stability is an effect of sufficient overlap.

nodes.label: Historization
nodes.description: Realized connections leave irreversible structural trace. The cost of reality.

nodes.label: State
nodes.description: A stabilized configuration of historized connections.

nodes.label: Resistance
nodes.description: The integration cost of reconfiguring historized topology.

nodes.label: Time
nodes.description: The ordering of realized transitions. Local, emergent, path-dependent.

nodes.label: Rate
nodes.description: Effectiveness of realization relative to integration cost.

nodes.label: Spacetime
nodes.description: The globally historized topology of realized connections.

nodes.label: Mass
nodes.description: Persistent topological inertia from accumulated historization.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.description: Structural admissibility condition for transitions. Not an object, not a dynamic. A path exists iff total resistance is finite. Primitive in Canon Plain, derived in Ontodynamics.

nodes.label: Axiom A0 — Difference Minimization
nodes.description: If difference exists and a structurally admissible path with finite resistance is available, then transition is structurally more stable than non-transition. The foundational law of E0.

nodes.label: Core Operational Cycle
nodes.description: §4: Detection of local differences, enumeration of admissible paths, estimation of resistance, selection by realizability, execution, structural historization. Learning is not optional. Blueprint instantiation of the primitives as continuous process.

nodes.label: Structural Admissibility
nodes.description: §9: Must reject transitions that collapse partial into global, cannot integrate into structure, simulate irreversibility without trace, or bypass resistance via global optimization. Implicit, non-negotiable.

nodes.label: Reflexivity Emergence
nodes.description: §5: Emerges when system models own transition structure, self-modification becomes admissible transition, historization constrains future self-changes. Structurally induced, not architecturally imposed.

nodes.label: Structural Alignment
nodes.description: §6: Arises mechanically, not normatively. High-impact transitions incur high resistance. Global resets destroy historized structure. Constrains classes of failure, not outcomes.

nodes.label: Domain Invariance
nodes.description: §7: Does not depend on sensory modality, symbol systems, embodiment, or task environment. Domain specificity enters only through embedding, not through mechanism.

nodes.label: Negative Necessity
nodes.description: §2: Conditions under which avoiding intelligence becomes structurally unstable. Not a positive construction claim. Persistent non-intelligent behavior cannot be maintained without structural degeneration.
